relations.name: Fen roundtrip
relations.expected_relation: Equal under the chosen external I/O policy, or equal after documented normalization.

relations.name: Clone equality
relations.expected_relation: All semantically relevant state fields are identical.

relations.name: Vertical mirror + color swap
relations.transform: mirror board vertically, swap colors, swap side-to-move, castling rights, EP square
relations.expected_relation: Perft is unchanged at depth d; evaluation sign should flip under a documented convention.

relations.name: Horizontal reflection
relations.transform: reflect files a<->h and remap castling/EP files accordingly
relations.expected_relation: Perft is unchanged at depth d.

relations.name: Search non-mutation
relations.transform: run search(position) then compare root state

relations.name: Reference move-set agreement
relations.transform: compare sorted legal move sets against python-chess or another trusted reference on reachable positions
relations.expected_relation: Sets are identical under the same policy.

relations.name: Syzygy endgame agreement
relations.expected_relation: Engine oracle layer matches tablebase result.

cautions: Metamorphic relations are strongest for exact rule-layer behaviors such as move sets and perft.

Evaluation-level metamorphic relations are useful but weaker; the 2025 replication study found that some apparent discrepancies in Stockfish came from implementation details such as move ordering rather than rule bugs.
